description:
FILED s522a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-19) from the #3061 acceptance runs: Text-CSV-2.04's t/util.pl transpiles now, and 15 t/ files run rows they never ran.  Every row below was checked against TWO emulations under real perl 5.40.3 (scratch/s522a/fu/run.sh: utf8::is_utf8 forced to 1 = #1389; fu/run2.sh: that PLUS Text::CSV_PP's `%{$self->{_CACHE}} = %$ctx` stores removed = #3611) and is NOT reproduced by either -- so it is a different mechanism.  Outputs: scratch/s522a/csv/<file>.out in the s522a worktree.

SILENT WRONG (pre-existing, identical on the aff112d7 base).

    for $\ (undef, "!") { print "a"; print "|" }   # perl a|a|    PCL a|a!|!
    for $/ ("\r") { open my $fh, "<", \"a\rb\r"; @r = <$fh> }  # perl 1 line   PCL 2
    for $, ("-") { print "x", "y" }                 # x-y in both ($, is read directly)

perl's `foreach` aliases the GV's scalar slot to each element without set-magic, so PL_ors_sv / PL_rs keep the value from before the loop.  PCL's foreach binds the special and print reads it.  Probe scratch/s522a/pr/ors.pl.  Text-CSV t/45_eol.t + t/46_eol_si.t loop `for $\ (undef, $rs)` and their `result |...|` rows 72 75 78 81 152 155 158 161 232 235 238 241 fail (attribution PROBABLE -- the rows sit exactly in the `$\` = $rs passes; confirm after the fix).  Fix belongs in the foreach lowering of a magic special loop variable (rule 11: one predicate for the special set).


=== DONE (s523d, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-22, commit 497da4f5) ===
perl keeps $\ / $/ in internal copies (PL_ors_sv / PL_rs) that only set-magic updates; foreach aliases without it, so for the loop's DYNAMIC extent print / readline / chomp keep the pre-loop value -- whatever the body (or a called sub) assigns to $\, even `local $\ = …` (probed 5.40.3: `for $\ (@e) { $\ = "!"; print "x" }` prints x; `$\="Q"; for $\ (@e) { print "z" }` prints zQ; nested loops keep the outermost).  cl/pcl-runtime.lisp: `%p-magic-loop-var-wrap` (one helper, the four foreach macros call it) binds *p-loop-frozen-ors* / *p-loop-frozen-rs* to a box of the pre-loop value (the outer one if already bound); p-print, %p-print-fixed-write and get-input-record-separator read `(or *p-loop-frozen-* |$\\|)`.  `for $, (…)` unchanged (perl reads $, directly).  Guard Pl/t/special-foreach-01.t (16 shapes = perl; inverse: base fails row 1).  Text-CSV 45_eol / 46_eol_si: see the s523d one-file runs (STOP.md).
subject: A foreach whose loop variable is $\ (or $/) changes the output (input) record separator in PCL; in perl the aliased loop variable does NOT reach print / readline (the magic is not set) -- Text-CSV 45_eol / 46_eol_si 12 rows each
